title: Dented/Works but smells toxic
text: Dented/Works but smells toxic. Dented two places. Toasts well - but smells dangerously toxic while doing so.

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach 22706 2 Slice Metal Toaster
features: Easy cleanup with slide-out crumb tray
High-lift toast boost makes it easier to reach small slices
Extra-wide slots accommodate thick breads and bagels
Cancel, bagel & defrost - stop toasting anytime, toast bagels, or defrost and toast frozen bread in one easy step

description: Make perfect toast in the Hamilton Beach 2 Slice Metal Toaster with the convenience of easy clean up and storage. This attractive toaster is made with a smudge proof brushed silver finish that won't show fingerprints.
